## Research

### Is the Dollar Reconnect Forecastable? Information Timing and Exchange-Rate Predictability

*Job Market Paper*

This paper studies whether the post-2007 reconnect between the U.S. dollar and global financial variables translates into real-time exchange-rate predictability. Using 13 currencies through December 2025, I compare feasible forecast-origin information with a realized-regressor benchmark for the same exchange-rate target. The reconnect is strong in realized data, but forecast-origin performance remains weak, showing that much of the apparent forecasting gain comes from information realized during the forecast window.
